vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Deep in the green jungle lives a big lion called Sunny.

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Roar! I'm Sunny! The biggest, strongest lion in the jungle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you roar like Sunny? Roooar!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Look at my big mane! Look at my big paws!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: I'm the best at everything!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny's friends are playing. Kiki the monkey, Bobo the bear, and little Pippa the mouse.

vo.speaker: kiki
vo.text: Sunny! Come and play hide and seek with us!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Hide and seek? That's a baby game! I'm too great for that!

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: Can I play with you, Sunny?

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: You? Ha! You're too small, little mouse. Small ones can't do anything!

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: Oh...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Pippa feels small, and sad. Being left out does not feel nice.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Was Sunny being kind? Hmm...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: No. Sunny was being too proud.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny walks off alone, with his nose up high.

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: I don't need anybody! La la la!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But he doesn't look where he's going... and walks right into a sticky, tangly bush!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Hey! My mane! My mane is stuck!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny pulls, and pulls, and pulls! But the vines hold on tight.

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Hmmmph! I'm the strongest... but I can't get out!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Help! Help! Can anybody help me?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bobo comes running. He pulls Sunny's paw. Heave, ho!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Heave... ho! Oof! It's too tangly!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Kiki tries too. She swings down from a branch!

vo.speaker: kiki
vo.text: Oo-oo! The vines are too tight!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who could help Sunny now? Think!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then... a tiny voice says:

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: I can help!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: You? But you're so small...

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: Small is good! My little teeth can nibble the vines!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Nibble, nibble, nibble! Pippa nibbles one vine... two vines... three vines!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's count the vines with Pippa! One... two... three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Snap! Sunny is free!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: I'm free! Pippa, you did it!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny looks at little Pippa. His face feels warm, and his tummy feels funny. That's a sorry feeling.

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Pippa... I'm sorry I said small ones can't do anything. I was wrong.

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: You're small, but you're very brave. Thank you!

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: That's OK, Sunny. Friends help friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny learned something new today. Big or small, everyone is special.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Being humble means: you don't have to be the best. You can just be a good friend.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now Sunny wants to play hide and seek!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Can I play with you, please?

vo.speaker: kiki
vo.text: Yes! Everybody can play!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sunny closes his eyes and counts. One, two, three! Ready or not!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where is Pippa hiding? Can you see her?

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: There you are, behind the flower! You're the best hider, Pippa!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And where is Sunny hiding? Behind a tiny leaf! Hee hee! We can see your tail, Sunny!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Ha ha! Big lions are not good at hiding!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now it's Kiki's turn to hide. Where is Kiki? Look up high!

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: There! Up in the tree! Monkeys love to climb!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And Bobo? Oh, Bobo, we can see your round ears!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hee hee! Bears are big too!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Big or small, we need each other.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who helped YOU today? Did you say thank you?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember! Are you ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Sunny say to little Pippa at first?

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: You're too small to play!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Pippa feel?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sad, and left out.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Pippa help Sunny?

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: I nibbled the vines! Nibble, nibble!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Sunny say after that?

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: I'm sorry! And thank you!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does humble mean?

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: You don't have to be the best. Just be a good friend!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say the lesson together!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Big or small...

vo.speaker: pippa
vo.text: we need each other!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Big or small, we need each other!

vo.speaker: sunny
vo.text: Goodbye, friends! Roar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
